workflowChecks.discovery: Every run has exact discovery recall and precision 1.0 (10/10 sites).
workflowChecks.dispositions: Every run has complete 10/10 coordinate disposition coverage.
workflowChecks.ordinaryExposure: Each Serene run had all seven ordinary bodies fully delivered during Discovery, then seven actual post-handoff skips. Raw had zero review-stage source reads in both tasks. Thus the observed skips did not create incremental source-read compression after handoff in this cohort.
workflowChecks.errorTreatment: All listed failed operations remain in the raw event logs and their response/request bytes are included in the reported stage and total costs; no reruns occurred.

ticketing.check: Direct summation of event response bytes equals each total. Serene total exceeds Raw by 3989 bytes; 3979 bytes are the handoff response, while Discovery differs by 10 and Review is equal.

stockroom.check: Direct summation of event response bytes equals each total. Serene total exceeds Raw by 5604 bytes: handoff contributes 3974, Discovery differs by 1065, and Review differs by 565 because Serene targeted-read the unmatched site.

interpretation: The four runs support complete exact discovery and dangerous-site diagnosis, with no logged false finding. They do not support an incremental source-read saving from Serene skips because every ordinary body was already read during Discovery. The handoff response adds substantial measured cost in both Serene runs; the further stockroom Discovery and Review differences are observed workflow differences and should be reported separately, not attributed to triage alone.
